injuries.name: Taylor Hall
injuries.note: Hall exited Tuesday's game against the Capitals due to his upper-body issue, and Brind'Amour said after the matchup that the injury didn't look good. The 34-year-old is now facing a multi-game absence, and it seems possible that he'll be placed on injured reserve at some point. Felix Unger Sorum could see time in the Hurricanes' lineup after being called up Thursday.

injuries.name: Seth Jarvis
injuries.note: Jarvis underwent offseason surgery to address a torn labrum and rotator cuff, but he was on the ice during training camp and could be close to making his regular-season debut after missing the first few weeks of the year. The 24-year-old racked up 32 goals, 34 assists, 81 hits, 27 blocked shots and 23 PIM while averaging 18:53 of ice time across 71 regular-season appearances last year.

injuries.name: Alexander Nikishin
injuries.note: Nikishin hasn't signed a new contract as a restricted free agent and has officially requested a trade, though nothing has materialized as of yet. Even if the young defenseman were on the roster, he may not be playing on a nightly basis, with Mike Reilly potentially ahead of him on the depth chart.

injuries.name: Elias Salomonsson
injuries.note: Salomonsson has spent the first few weeks of the regular season recovering from shoulder surgery that he underwent in late April. He's believed to be ahead of schedule in his recovery and was targeting a return to game action by mid-October, but he'll miss another game Thursday. It's not yet clear when he'll get the green light to return, but it seems likely that he'll be in the mix to suit up sooner rather than later given his previous return timetable.

injuries.name: Taylor Hall
injuries.note: Upper Body: The Hurricanes reported on Friday (Oct. 16) that Hall is is considered week-to-week, per Chip Alexander of The Raleigh News & Observer.

injuries.name: Seth Jarvis
injuries.note: Shoulder: The Carolina Hurricanes said on Friday (Oct. 16) that Jarvis plans to travel with the Hurricanes during their upcoming five-game road trip, per Ryan Henkel of The Hockey News.

injuries.name: Jordan Staal
injuries.note: Calf: The Carolina Hurricanes placed F Jordan Staal on injured reserve on Thursday (Oct. 15).

injuries.name: Garrett Brown
injuries.note: Lower-body: The Winnipeg Jets placed D Garrett Brown on injured reserve and he'll now be reevaluated in a couple of weeks.

injuries.name: Walker Duehr
injuries.note: Lower-body: The Jets said that Duehr returned to Winnipeg's practice in a regular jersey on Friday (Oct. 16).

injuries.name: Josh Morrissey
injuries.note: Upper Body: The Jets said on Thursday (Oct. 15) that Morrissey has been downgraded to week-to-week.

injuries.name: Vladislav Namestnikov
injuries.note: Undisclosed: Namestnikov is week-to-week, per Mitchell Clinton of the Jets' official site.

injuries.name: Elias Salomonsson
injuries.note: Shoulder: The Jets said that Salomonsson is OUT for Thursday's (Oct. 15) game against the Blackhawks, per Mike McIntyre of the Winnipeg Free Press.
